title: 第558章 接连两套算计惊呆九千岁第557章 扶持李青幽闹事当女帝
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
嘶……
被沈浪这么一提醒，九千岁的眼睛亮了。
他觉得沈浪的这个提议，真的是太妙了！
只要他不将沈浪当成合作者，李青幽便不会怀疑是沈浪算计了她。
甚至，在她知道沈浪的身份后，更是有可能因为心中的恨意，与沈浪进行合作。
到那时……
凭借沈浪的三寸不烂之舌，还真的有可能拿下李青幽。
但想到此事太过于巨大。
哪怕九千岁已经初步认可了沈浪的计划，还是忍不住的追问道：
“话虽然是这么说的，但圣人云，不怕一万就怕万一！”
“万一李青幽，迟迟迈不过心底的那道坎，亦或者做不好这件事，该怎么整？！”
沈浪笑着眯起眼道：“我不是说了，我有三种方法，可以确保此事可以成功吗？”
“对对对，你的确说了三种方法，那你接下来的两种方法是什么？”
看着九千岁一脸期待的神情，沈浪笑着眯起眼道：“第二种方法，便是舆论宣传法！”
“舆论宣传法？”
九千岁听到这里，刚刚放下的心，猛然提到了嗓子眼。
“你该不会是打算将王莽喜好人妻的事情宣传出去吧？”
“我可告诉你，这里是儒道世界，强者遍地，你若是敢做此事，必然会被查到！”
“到那时，我可救不了你！”
沈浪也不是刚踏入社会的小年轻了。

自然很清楚，造谣是需要付出代价的！
但很可惜他可不是普通人！
这种低端的事情，他怎么可能会去做？
“老爷子，你误会我的意思了！”
“我不会亲自出去造谣，周伯通他会替我把这事说出去的！”
“啥玩意？！”
九千岁听到沈浪这话，当场就懵了。
周伯通会主动把这件事说出去的？
这不是开玩笑吗？
周伯通那个老家伙，虽然做事情耿直，但他可不是傻子呀。
要不然，王莽喜好的人妻的癖好，早就传出去了，不可能等到现在。
所以，觉得沈浪想的实在是有些多的九千岁，也是一脸古怪道：“我觉得你想的有些天真了！”
“毕竟，满朝文武其实都知道王莽有喜好人妻的毛病，只是大家碍于王莽的身份，不敢明言罢了！”
沈浪自然清楚，当下属的就喜欢背后蛐蛐自家上司。
但沈浪更清楚，背后蛐蛐都是建立在大家没有撕破脸的情况下。
倘若撕破脸了……
谁他娘的还在乎自家老板的脸面？
“老爷子，您怕是忘了，周伯通可是大周的宰相，是大周第二大利益集合体！”
“他麾下的人，我可以确保80%的人，都有各种毛病！”
“您觉得王莽突然对崔勇下手，他们在听到这个消息之后，会生出什么念头？”

嘶……
被沈浪这么一提醒，九千岁再度倒吸了一口冷气。
他觉得沈浪说的有道理！
虽说王莽明面上只是想要李青幽，满足自己的兽欲。
content_en:
Hiss...
Being reminded like this by Shen Lang, Jiu Qianqian's eyes lit up.
He felt that Shen Lang's proposal was really wonderful!
As long as he did not regard Shen Lang as a collaborator, Li Qingyou would not suspect that Shen Lang had plotted against her.
Even after she knew Shen Lang's identity, she might cooperate with Shen Lang because of the hatred in her heart.
Until then…
With Shen Lang's sharp tongue, it is really possible to win over Li Qingyou.
But thinking about this is too huge.
Even though Nine Thousand Years Old had initially approved of Shen Lang's plan, he still couldn't help but ask:
"Although that's what I said, the sage said, don't be afraid of ten thousand, just be afraid of the worst!"
"What if Li Qingyou fails to overcome the hurdle in his heart, or cannot do this well?!"
Shen Lang smiled and narrowed his eyes: "Didn't I say that I have three ways to ensure the success of this matter?"
"Yes, yes, you did say three methods, then what are your next two methods?"
Seeing the expectant look on Jiu Qiansui's face, Shen Lang smiled and narrowed his eyes and said: "The second method is the public opinion propaganda method!"
"Public Opinion Propaganda Law?"
When Jiu Qiansui heard this, his heart that had just been relieved suddenly rose to his throat.
"Are you planning to publicize Wang Mang's preference for wives?"
"I can tell you, this is a world of Confucianism and Taoism, and strong people are everywhere. If you dare to do this, you will definitely be found out!"
"Until then, I can't save you!"
Shen Lang is no longer a young man who has just entered society.
Naturally, it is clear that there is a price to pay for spreading rumors!
But unfortunately he is not an ordinary person!
How could he do such a low-end thing?
"Old man, you misunderstood me!"
"I won't go out and spread rumors myself, Zhou Botong will tell the truth for me!"
"What the hell?!"
When Jiu Qiansui heard Shen Lang's words, he was stunned on the spot.
Will Zhou Botong take the initiative to tell this matter?
Isn't this a joke?
Although that old guy Zhou Botong is upright, he is not a fool.
Otherwise, Wang Mang's preference for wives would have been spread out long ago, and it would have been impossible to wait until now.
Therefore, he felt that Shen Lang was really thinking too much about the nine thousand years old, so he said with a strange expression: "I think you are a little naive!"
"After all, everyone in the court knew that Wang Mang liked wives, but they didn't dare to say it openly because of Wang Mang's status!"
Shen Lang naturally knew that when he was a subordinate, he liked to play cricket behind his boss's back.
But Shen Lang knew better that the cricket behind the scenes was based on the fact that everyone did not break up.
If we break up...
Who the hell cares about their boss’s face?
"Old man, I'm afraid you have forgotten that Zhou Botong is the prime minister of the Great Zhou Dynasty and the second largest group of interests in the Great Zhou Dynasty!"
"I can ensure that 80% of the people under his command have various problems!"
"Do you think Wang Mang suddenly attacked Cui Yong? What thoughts will they have after hearing the news?"
Hiss...
Being reminded by Shen Lang, Jiu Qiansui took a breath of air again.
He thinks what Shen Lang said makes sense!
Although Wang Mang clearly just wanted Li Qingyou to satisfy his animal desires.
